description.en:
"Those with blood on their blades don't cross the Lower Yangtze."

No So-ha, the sole heir to the reputedly invincible Nine Flow Swordsmanship, lives a low-profile life with three sources of income: fishing, ferrying customers across the Lower Yangtze, and as a contract hitman for victims of injustice. Despite trying to stay away from the conflicts among martial arts factions, he finds himself taking up the most dangerous job of all: escorting to safety in Korea a girl who holds the missing part of the Sun Gun Gyung, a 1,500-year-old medical treatise written for Emperor Qin Shi Huang that is the key to achieving immortality.

A Korean xianxia webtoon about a blade-for-hire's adventure in Yuan China.
description.pt-br:
"Aqueles com sangue em suas lâminas não cruzam o Baixo Yangtzé."
No So-ha, único herdeiro da lendária e invencível Técnica das Nove Correntes da Espada, leva uma vida discreta com três fontes de renda: pesca, transporte de clientes pelo Baixo Yangtzé e como um assassino de aluguel contratado para vítimas de injustiça. Apesar de tentar se afastar dos conflitos entre as facções das artes marciais, ele acaba assumindo o trabalho mais perigoso de todos: escoltar com segurança até a Coreia uma garota que possui a parte perdida do Sun Gun Gyung, um tratado médico de 1.500 anos escrito para o Imperador Qin Shi Huang, a chave para alcançar a imortalidade.

description.en:
“Awaken a New Self”. Lee Oh Reum is a high schooler who plays as a “Healer Shuttle” character in the kinesthetic VR MMORPG game <Ergosphere Online>.
One day, his sub character “Avenger” that he was secretly raising becomes the best.
Will Lee Oh Reum be able to overcome all dangers like constantly appearing monsters and various quests to become his new self? An authentic action altermodern drama fantasy.
description.it: "Risvegliati". Lee Oh Reum è un liceale che gioca come un personaggio "Healer " nel VR MMORPG gioco . Un giorno, il suo personaggio secondario "Avenger" che stava segretamente allenando diventa il migliore. Lee Oh Reum sarà in grado di superare tutti i pericoli come mostri che appaiono costantemente e varie missioni?

체감형 VR MMORPG 게임 <에르고스피어 온라인>에서 "힐러 셔틀"을 하던 고등학생 이오름은 
어느날 자신이 남몰래 키워둔 최강의 부캐 "어벤져"가 되어버리고 만다. 
그리고 연이어 나타나는 몬스터들과 각종 퀘스트들. 
이오름은 모든 위기를 이겨내고 새로운 내가 될 수 있을까. 
본격 부캐 활극 현대 판타지.
description.pt-br:
"Desperte seu Novo Eu" Lee Oh-reum é um estudante do ensino médio que sobrevive como um "Healer Shuttle" — um curandeiro explorado e subestimado — no imersivo VR MMORPG de tecnologia cinestésica, <Ergosphere Online>.

No entanto, o que ninguém sabe é que ele cultiva secretamente um sub-personagem: "Avenger". Quando esse avatar oculto alcança o topo da hierarquia global, a vida de Oh-reum vira de cabeça para baixo.

Entre hordas incessantes de monstros e missões de alto risco, conseguirá Lee Oh-reum superar os perigos e deixar sua antiga identidade para trás? Uma narrativa autêntica de ação e drama altermoderno.

description.ar: االأميرة هينناايل بلااكي، أميرة مملكة ساالر، قُتلت على يد زوجهاا بيننماا كااننت حااملااً.ظننت أنن حيااتهاا ااننتهت، لكننهاا فتحت عيننيهاا لتجد ننفسهاا قد عاادت إلى ماا قبل زوااجهاا بعاامينن.“في هذه االحيااة، لنن أؤمنن بشيء يُدعى االحب.”ولكي لاا توااجه ننفس االمستقبل االتعيس مرة أخرى، قررت تغيير قدرهاا وااختياار رجل آخر. فااختاارت لوث بيااننتي، االمعروف بشبح االحرب لتريننكااس واالذي سيصبح في يوم منن االأياام إمبرااطور تريننكااس.“سألد طفلك، وأطلب مننك حماايته كخليفة.”في هذه االحيااة، ستضمنن حمااية طفلهاا االذي ستحصل عليه منن رجل آخر.
description.en: “Fate, save my unborn child…!” These are the last words of Princess Hinael as she plummets to her death at the hands of Count Chetaire, her unfaithful husband. Little does Hinael know that destiny will grant her a second chance, as she awakens two years in the past, shortly before her marriage. With her knowledge of what’s to come, Hinael attempts to rewrite the stars for herself and her future child. And what better way to achieve her ambitions than to court her kingdom’s former enemy, the dark and stern Prince Lutz of the Empire of Triekas?
description.es:
Hinael Plaque, la princesa del Reino de Salen, fue traicionada y asesinada por el hombre que amaba, incluso mientras llevaba a su hijo en el vientre.
Cuando creyó que todo había terminado, abrió los ojos para descubrir que había regresado al pasado, dos años antes de su fatídico matrimonio.
«En esta vida, no caeré en las trampas del amor.»
Decidida a cambiar su destino, Hinael eligió un camino diferente y se acercó a Lutz Biant, conocido como el temido «fantasma de la guerra» y futuro emperador del imperio de Tricas.
«Quiero tener un hijo suyo. Por favor, proteja al heredero que traeré al mundo.»
Esta vez, Hinael hará lo que sea necesario para proteger a su hijo, incluso si eso significa aliarse con el hombre más peligroso del continente.

---
—Si quieres ser mi esposa, deberás trabajar incansablemente en mi dormitorio para darme un heredero.

La princesa Hinael de Sarr fue asesinada por su marido mientras estaba embarazada. Creyendo que su vida había terminado, inesperadamente se encontró enviada dos años atrás en el tiempo.

En esta nueva vida, criaré al niño que está en mi vientre como [el hijo de otro hombre].

En un momento desesperado, un hombre que podría salvarla vino a su mente: Lutz Viant, el Dios de la Guerra, el futuro Emperador del Imperio Trycas.

—Lo haré, si eso es lo que quieres. 

—Bien, tienes espíritu.

Para sobrevivir, Hinael decide cumplir con sus deberes como esposa...

===

—Puede que no puedas caminar mañana.

Al principio, pensó que era solo una exageración. Pero...

—¿Has olvidado lo rudo que puedo llegar a ser?

Aunque se trataba de una relación transaccional, él se entusiasmó increíblemente desde la primera noche.

—No puedo controlarme, mi cuerpo es diferente de lo habitual.

Hooh… En aquel entonces, ella no sabía por qué él se agitaba como una fiera.
description.fr: La princesse Hinael du royaume de Sarl est poussée du haut d'une falaise par son époux dont elle attend un enfant. Alors qu'elle pense mourir, elle se réveille soudainement deux ans plus tôt. Pour changer son destin, elle décide que l'héritier qu'elle portera cette fois-ci sera celui d'un autre homme. Elle demande alors à Lutz Viant, le prince fanatique de guerre qui deviendra plus tard empereur de Trikas, de la choisir pour épouse.
description.id: “Aku tidak akan percaya cinta di kehidupan kali ini.” Hinael Flake, putri Kerajaan Salle, dibunuh oleh Cether Phil saat sedang hamil anak mereka. Beruntung, dia mendapatkan kesempatan kedua dan kembali ke masa dua tahun sebelum dia menikah dengan Cether. Demi menghindari masa depan yang malang, dia mengubah nasibnya dan memilih pria lain untuk menjadi suaminya. Pilihannya jatuh kepada Lutz Viant, pangeran kedua kekaisaran Tricas yang dikenal sebagai iblis perang. “Di kehidupan kali ini, aku pasti akan melindungi anakku yang kumiliki dengan pria lain.”
description.ko:
살르 왕국의 왕녀, 히나엘 플라케.
그녀는 만삭의 몸으로 남편에게 살해당했다.

그렇게 생이 끝난 줄 알았는데...

눈을 떠 보니, 결혼 2년 전으로 돌아왔다.

'이번 생에선 사랑 같은 것은 믿지 않겠어.'

또다시 불행한 미래를 맞지 않기 위해,

운명을 바꾸어 다른 남자를 선택했다.

트리카스의 전쟁귀라고 불리는, 장차 트리카스의 황제가 될 루츠 비안트.

"당신의 아이를 낳겠습니다. 제가 낳을 아이를 후계로서 보호해 주세요."

이번 생에는 반드시 내 아이를,

다른 남자와의 사이에서 얻은 내 아이를 지킬 것이다.
description.ru:
Принцесса королевства Саль — Хинэль Флэйк. 
Её убил её же муж, пока она была беременна. 
И, казалось бы, на этом оборвётся её жизнь... 
Но когда она открыла глаза, оказалось, что она вернулась на два года назад в прошлое до свадьбы. 

«В этой жизни я не буду верить в любовь». 

Чтобы пойти против своей судьбы и избежать несчастья, 
Она решила выбрать другого мужчину. 
Руз Виант — принц империи Триска, его часто называют «демоном войны». 

«Я рожу вам ребёнка. А вы должны будете сделать его наследником.» 

В этот раз...
Я обязательно защищу своего ребёнка.
description.th: เจ้าหญิงฮินาเอล ฟลาเก้แห่งอาณาจักรซาลล์ ถูกสามีของเธอฆ่าขณะท้องแก่ เมื่อคิดว่าชีวิตของเธอได้จบสิ้นลงแล้ว... เธอพบว่าตัวเองได้ย้อนกลับมาเมื่อสองปีก่อนงานแต่งงานของเธอ 'ครั้งนี้ ฉันจะไม่เชื่อเรื่องความรักอะไรนั่นอีกแล้ว' เพื่อที่จะหลีกเลี่ยงอนาคตอันโหดร้ายที่จะเกิดขึ้น ฉันจึงตัดสินใจที่จะเปลี่ยนแปลงโชคชะตาของตัวเองและเลือกอยู่กับชายคนใหม่แทน ชายที่ผู้คนเรียกว่า วีรบุรุษสงครามแห่งทริคัส ชายผู้มีโชคชะตาที่จะได้กลายเป็นจักรพรรดิ "รูธ เวียนต์" "ฉันจะคลอดลูกของคุณ ช่วยปกป้องเด็กคนนี้ในฐานะทายาทของคุณด้วย" คราวนี้ ฉันจะปกป้องลูกของฉันให้ได้ ลูกของฉันกับชายอีกคนหนึ่ง
description.vi:
"Nếu cô muốn trở thành vợ của tôi, cô phải cố gắng sinh ra người thừa kế tại phòng ngủ của tôi cả ngày lẫn đêm"

Tôi, Hinael, công chúa của đế quốc Salah đã bị chồng giết chết khi mang thai. Tôi cứ tưởng mọi thứ đã kết thúc như thế, nhưng tôi đã vượt qua ranh giới sống còn và trở về 2 năm trước.

Ở cuộc đời này, tôi muốn nói với đứa con chưa chào đời của mình rằng tôi sẽ nuôi dạy nó thành con của người đàn ông khác.

Vào khoảnh khắc tôi rơi vào tuyệt vọng, có một người đàn ông đã xuất hiện và cứu rỗi tôi. Đó là Rutskian, hoàng đế tương lai của đế quốc Trichas và được biết đến với cái tên ác ma chiến trường.

"Tôi sẽ làm tất cả, chỉ cần anh muốn là được"

"Tinh thần tốt đấy chứ"

Để sống sót, tôi quyết định sẽ làm tròn bổn phận của một người vợ...

===
"Có thể ngày mai em sẽ không đi được đâu"

Ban đầu, tôi không tin lời anh ta nói là sự thật. Nhưng...

"Anh đâu có nói với tôi là nó sẽ dữ dội đến vậy đâu?"

Mặc dù giữa chúng ta chỉ là mối quan hệ giao dịch. Nhưng kể từ khi trải qua đêm đầu tiên, anh ta tự dưng lại phấn khích vô cùng.

"Tôi không nghĩ mình có thể kiểm soát được bản thân vì cơ thể tôi khác thường lắm. Ha..."

Vào lúc đó, tôi vẫn chưa biết được tại sao anh ta lại giống như một con thú hoang đến vậy.
description.zh:
选择命运之外的男人，
为自己和孩子拼未来！
萨勒王国的公主被丈夫杀害于临盆之际，以为一切结束，却意外回到了两年前的婚前时光。发誓不再相信爱情的她，为改变悲惨命运，选择了被称为“战神”的特里卡斯皇帝候选人。“我会为您生下孩子，请保护他成为继承人。”
这一世，她誓要守护自己的孩子，哪怕是与另一个男人所生的孩子！
description.pt-br:
Princesa Hinael Plake do Reino de Salur. Ela foi assassinada por seu marido enquanto estava grávida. Justo quando eu pensei que minha vida havia acabado. Abri meus olhos e me encontrei dois anos antes do meu casamento.

'Desta vez, eu não acreditarei em coisas como amor.'

Para evitar enfrentar outro futuro infeliz, decidi mudar meu destino e escolher outro homem. Aquele que eles chamam de Herói de Guerra de Trikas, destinado a se tornar o Imperador de Trikas, Lutz Viant.

"Eu carregarei seu filho. Por favor, proteja a criança que eu der à luz como seu herdeiro."

Desta vez, eu protegerei meu filho, aquele que terei com outro homem.
description.zh-hk: 薩爾王國的公主希娜爾．弗拉克在臨產之際慘遭丈夫殺害。 原以為生命將劃下句點…一睜開眼，卻發現回到了結婚兩年前。 「今生的我不會再相信愛情了。」 為了避免悲慘的未來重蹈覆轍，希娜爾選擇了人稱特里卡斯的戰爭狂—— 未來將成為特里卡斯皇帝的魯茨．維安特。 「我會為你生下孩子，請讓我的孩子成為繼承人，並好好保護他。」 希娜爾誓言，無論如何，都要守護前世的孩子，改寫命運的悲劇。

In her eighth year of possessing the body of an extra in a novel, she met the book’s protagonist who she thought was a woman disguised as a man. But he was actually a man! How will this novel’s ending play out?

Aine has lived for eight years without even knowing which novel she had transmigrated to. And then, one day, she meets a knight and discovers the novel she is in.

This man is actually a woman?!
The female lead who is disguised as a man to replace her dead brother?!
Then, I’ll live a comfortable life as her friend!

However, this woman is acting strangely…
To think she was actually a man! What should I do now that I’m involved with him?

“Do you really see me as a woman?”

description.en: While amateur photographer HyunWoo was working in a coffee shop, a woman appeared, shining light in her boring daily life. At the same time, HyunWoo secretly took photos of her, making her unconsciously fall for her. However, after being found taking her secret photo, she was discovered, making her life turn upside down. And, it turns out that she's the girlfriend of her brother..

With a status of a slave, Azrael has served a noble’s whipping child. In this misery, one mysterious man comes into her life.  
  
“Why are you living a life like this?”  
“Do you know me?”  
  
In the three years of her life she’s forgotten, the one who gave her a name was the Wizard of the Horizon, Rhema Resht. His kindness yet lacking something, caught her attention. She wanted him to be as happy as she was.  
  
“The more you get to know me, misfortune will come.”  
“I promise I won’t be miserable, Rhema. So, please teach me magic.”  
  
———————————————————————————————  
  
This is a short webtoon to promote the light novel, "Fairytale for Wizards!" You could check out the English translation of the novel on tumblr or novel sharing sites.

The moment she believed she won, everything went back to the beginning.

Kalmia Phlox, whose dead brother came to life, was engaged to a man she was close to, and had a relationship with the man she was in love with. In her very different relationships, she comes closer to a truth she did not know in her previous life…

“It’s greed to wish for something you don’t have the ability to handle!”

“Yes, I know. I’m being greedy. Do I need permission to be greedy?”

She’ll be the Countess again in this life. It’s not a lucky title, but it was won with her own strength, so she’ll be a perfect Countess who is nobody’s scarecrow.

---
Calmia Phlox is given a second chance at life, but this time, she must compete against her beloved twin brother to gain back her coveted status and title as Countess Phlox. What’s more, her nemesis wants to... marry her?! Striking a deal with her former archenemy, Rudbeckia, while struggling between her ambitions and her fondness for her brother, will Calmia reclaim what is hers?

description.en:
After possessing the eldest daughter of Count Leire, Archel, she became the head of the family following her parents' death. The only way to protect her little brother and herself from the old foxes who are after her family was…

"I know that you need Leire's sea territory."

In order to acquire a shield called Gael von Zenat, the infamous guardian of the eastern sea, but in reality, he was the head of a pirate family.

"I'll give you the sea territory there. So, please marry me."

It wasn't a romantic proposal. It was just a perfect deal. He would take care of her family's waters, and she would protect her brother and herself. She thought so, but…

"When I graduate, be sure to divorce my sister."

"I think I've already told you that I don't want to divorce her."

The relationship between her brother and husband is strange.

===

"Gael, stop it," she tried to move away but Gael didn’t budge at all.

"What do you mean? I said that I believe you, didn't I?"

"No," Archel said after a moment of silence.

"For real, it seems like you really do. I swear it seemed like you love me."

That's just an illusion.

After watching my expression, the smile disappeared from Gael's face, "Am I mistaken?"

description.fr:
Après avoir possédé la fille aînée du Comte Leire, Archel , devint le chef de famille à la mort de ses parents. La seule façon de protéger son petit frère et elle-même des vieux renards qui en ont après sa famille était…

«Je sais que vous avez besoin du territoire maritime de Leire.»

Afin d'acquérir un bouclier appelé Gael Von Zenat, l'infâme gardien de la mer orientale, mais en réalité, il était le chef d'une famille de pirates.

«Je vais vous donner le territoire maritime là-bas. Alors, s'il vous plaît, épousez-moi.»

Ce n'était pas une proposition romantique. C'était juste une affaire parfaite. Tu prends soin de la mer de notre famille, et je me protégerai moi et mon frère.

Je le pensais, mais…

«Quand j'aurai mon diplôme, assurez-vous de divorcer de ma sœur.»

«Je pense que je vous ai déjà dit que je ne veux pas divorcer.»

La relation entre les deux est inhabituelle.

===

«Gaël, arrête ça.»

Elle essaya de s'éloigner mais Gael ne bougea pas du tout.

«Que veux-tu dire? J'ai dit que je croyais en toi, n'est-ce pas?»

«Non.»

Dit Archel après un moment de silence.

«Pour de vrai, il semble que vous le fassiez vraiment. Je jure que tu avais l'air de m'aimer.»

Ce n'est qu'une illusion.

Après avoir observé mon expression, un sourire a disparu du visage de Gaël.

«Est-ce que je me trompe?»

Jadi, tolong menikahlah denganku.” Itu bukan lamaran romantis. Itu hanya kesepakatan yang sempurna. Anda menjaga laut keluarga kami, dan saya akan melindungi diri saya dan saudara laki-laki saya. Hubungan antara keduanya tidak biasa. *** "Gael, hentikan." Dia mencoba menjauh tapi Gael tidak bergeming sama sekali. "Apa maksudmu? Saya mengatakan bahwa saya percaya pada Anda, bukan? "TIDAK." description.en:
After her mother's death, Elrose Basellan was cast out by her father for 14 years. With news of his passing, Elrose rushes to claim her inheritance, but can't do so unless she's married! Desperate, she prays for a husband, and the mysterious Rakshan seems to fall from the sky! They agree to a temporary union that benefits them both, but unexpected issues keep delaying their plans for divorce. Will this fake marriage become something more? Or should Elrose have chosen her husband more carefully?

---
After her mother’s death, Elrose is left alone in a monastery, while her father stripped of her of her fortune. When news of his passing reaches her, she must flee the monastery and marry within hours to claim her rightful inheritance and title. Desperate, she prays for a husband and fate brings a man to her feet. Little does she know that this man is Lachsann, the man who stole her money. Despite her mother’s warning to “choose a husband carefully,” she can’t do so in this situation and proposes to Lachsann.

“Do you have no intention of repaying me, except for your body?”

Unbeknownst to her, Lachsann isn’t just any man but the emperor’s brother and the king of mercenaries, Harkhan.
description.fr: Après la mort de sa mère, Elrose se retrouve seule dans un monastère, tandis que son père est privé de sa fortune. Lorsque la nouvelle de son décès lui parvient, elle doit fuir le monastère et se marier quelques heures plus tard pour réclamer son héritage et son titre légitimes. Désespérée, elle prie pour un mari et le destin remet un homme sur ses pieds. Elle ne sait pas que cet homme est Lachsann, l'homme qui lui a volé son argent. Malgré l’avertissement de sa mère de «choisir son mari avec soin,» elle ne peut pas le faire dans cette situation et propose à Lachsann. 'N'as-tu pas l'intention de me rembourser, sauf pour ton corps?' À son insu, Lachsann n’est pas n’importe quel homme mais le frère de l’empereur et roi des mercenaires, Harkhan.

description.ko:
어머니가 세상을 떠난 뒤 아버지에게 재산을 빼앗기고 수도원의 오두막에서 홀로 사는 엘로즈.
아버지의 사망했다는 소식을 듣고서 유산과 작위를 물려받기 위해 수도원을 탈출해 수도로 향한다.
하지만 자신의 것을 상속받으려면 몇 시간 내로 결혼을 해야 하는 상황.

“신이시여, 제 남편 될 사람 한 명만 좀 보내 주시면 안될까요? 가능하시면 지금 당장 부탁드려요.”

신께서 기도를 들어준 것일까?
때마침 앞에 웬 남자가 엘로즈의 앞으로 굴러떨어졌다!

돌아가신 어머니가 “남편을 고를 때는 신중하렴.”이라고 말했지만 그럴 수 없는 상황.
엘로즈는 자신의 돈을 가져간 라크샨이라는 남자에게 제안한다.

description.ru:
После смерти матери Элроуз остается одна в монастырской хижине, а её отец лишается всего имущества.
Узнав о смерти отца, она сбежала из монастыря и направилась в столицу, чтобы забрать принадлежащие ей наследство и титул. Однако оказалось, что если она хочет получить наследство, то должна выйти замуж в течение нескольких часов.

— "Боже, пошли мне мужчину в мужья! Если можно, пожалуйста, сделай это прямо сейчас.”

Прислушался ли Бог к её молитвам?
Как раз в это время перед Элроуз упал человек! Ее покойная мать говорила: “Выбирай мужа с осторожностью.”

Элроуз сделала предложение мужчине по имени Ракшан, который взял у неё взаймы деньги.

— "Может отплатишь мне своим телом, а не деньгами?”

Она и подумать не могла, что Ракшан — брат императора и король наемников.
description.uk:
Після смерті матінки, Елроуз полишають саму у монастирі, а її батько відбирає законний спадок. Коли звістка про його смерть доходить до дівчини, вона втікає з монастиря та має вийти заміж за кілька годин, щоб мати змогу претендувати на свій законний спадок та титул.

Зневірившись, Елроуз молиться Богові про чоловіка, а доля кидає його прям їй під ноги. Вона й не відає нічого про нього, окрім того, що Ракшан – людина, яка вкрала в неї гроші.

Незважаючи на застереження матері «ретельно обирати чоловіка», вона не може вчинити так в цій ситуації. Елроуз робить пропозицію Ракшану, чоловіку, котрий обікрав її.

«Не хочеш відплатити мені своїм тілом?»

Вона й гадки не має, що Ракшан не простий чоловік, а брат Імператора та Король Найманців, Гаркан.

description.en: A thousand-year plan was ruined by a beautiful boy raised in the forest. In the end, Ariel abandoned the boy. 10 years later. That same boy, Cedric, who harbored a grudge for being abandoned, invades the forest. And Cedric, in the midst of the blazing fire that burns the forest, "Let's get married, Ariel." He proposed. Ariel, age-1000+ , occupation-great wizard. I guess... I need to rewrite my life plan?!
description.id: Rencana seribu tahun Ariel, sang penyihir agung, hancur akibat kehadiran Cedric, seorang anak laki-laki menawan di tengah hutan. Setelah merawatnya selama beberapa tahun, Ariel meninggalkan anak laki-laki itu dan kembali tertidur. 10 tahun kemudian, Cedric yang dendam setelah ditinggalkan, kembali ke hutan dan membakarnya. Di tengah kobaran api, Cedric mengajukan hal yang di luar dugaan. “Ayo kita menikah, Ariel.” Bagaimana Ariel menanggapi permintaan tak masuk akal yang diajukan Cedric?!
description.ja: 森でかくまっていた美しい少年のせいで、千年の計画が台無しになってしまった。 アリエルはその少年を見捨てることを選択する。 10年後、捨てられたことに恨みを抱いていたかつての少年セドリックが森に攻め込んでくる。 そしてセドリックは森を焼き尽くす炎の中で ｢結婚しよう、アリエル｣とプロポーズした。 アリエル、年齢:1,000歳+＠、職業:大魔法使い。(特記事項:魔力なし) どうやら…人生計画を立て直さなきゃいけないみたい!?
description.ko:
숲에서 거둔 아름다운 소년 때문에 천년의 계획이 망가져 버렸다.  
결국 아리엘은 그 소년을 버렸다.  
10년 후.  버림 받은 원한을 품은 소년, 세드릭이 숲에 쳐들어 온다.  
그리고 세드릭은  숲을 활활 태우는 불길 속에서,  
“결혼하자, 아리엘.”  
이라며 청혼했다.  
아리엘, 나이-1000살+@, 직업-대마법사. (특이사항 : 마력 없음)  
아무래도… 인생 계획을 새로 짜야겠는데?!
description.th: แผนที่วางมากว่าพันปีต้องถูกทำลายลงเพราะเด็กหนุ่มรูปงามที่เจอในป่า แต่ถึงสุดท้าย แอเรียลจะทิ้งเด็กคนนั้นไปเถอะ สิบปีต่อมา เซดริก เด็กชายคนเดิมผู้เคียดแค้นที่เคยถูกทอดทิ้งได้บุกรุกเข้าไปในป่า และท่ามกลางเปลวไฟโหมกระหน่ำที่กำลังเผาป่าอยู่นั้น "แต่งงานกันเถอะ แอเรียล" เซดริกกล่าว แอเรียล: อายุ 1000+ ปี อาชีพจอมเวท (หมายเหตุ: ไม่มีพลังเวท) ฉันว่า… ฉันคงต้องวางแผนชีวิตใหม่แล้วใช่ไหมนะ?!
description.zh:

与年下皇帝的爱恋
千年计划因森林里收留的美丽少年而打乱。最终爱丽尔抛弃了那个少年。10年后，怀恨在心的少年塞德里克闯入了森林。他在熊熊燃烧的森林大火中求婚道：“我们结婚吧，爱丽尔。”爱丽尔，年龄…1000岁+，职业大魔法师，特别事项:没有魔力。看来…要重新制定人生计划了!!
description.zh-hk: 森林裡的美麗少年毀了我的千年計畫！ 愛莉爾最終拋棄了少年。 十年後，他懷著當初被拋棄的恨，率軍入侵了她的森林，在熊熊燃燒的烈焰中向她求婚...？

Since childhood, Ian Gloucester believed he was cursed to live as a destructive monster. He carried out his days in faithful servitude to the savior who plucked him from the depths of hell, Cardinal Brixton. But, one day, a mysterious man named Soleite Winkler, who shares the same "curse", tells him that this power is actually... magic. As a result, Ian begins to question everything he's ever known. The two reluctantly form an alliance to expose the corruption that lies within the Kingdom. Despite his loyalty to the strict and religious Cardinal, Ian is drawn to Sol and slowly begins to fall for him. For the first time in his life, he isn't alone. As Ian finally learns to embrace who he really is, will he also embrace the newfound lover who set him free? *(Source: Tappytoon)*

description.en:
Sierra's peaceful village life is disrupted when her ex-boyfriend, Duke Cassius Ideos, shows up and mistakes the child she's raising as his daughter. The thing is, the girl is her niece, not her kid! When he refuses to listen to any explanation, her only option is to follow him to his duchy and await the results of a paternity test. All Sierra has to do is keep to herself for three months, but will things remain that simple when she begins to suspect that the duke still has feelings for her?
___
Six years ago, Sierra broke up with her ex-boyfriend, Cassius, without a word. Now he's back as a duke, claiming he regrets abandoning her. But wait, wasn’t she the one who ended things? To make matters worse, he starts getting strange ideas after meeting Hanael, her 5-year-old niece whom she's been raising in place of her sister. "I had no idea, Sierra. I never knew you were raising our child all alone…" Hanael, who had been hiding, suddenly yells at Cassius instead of being shy. "Please, stop denying it... our relationship, and our child." "You're a bad man! You abandoned us!" No, Hanael, he didn't abandon you. And I'm not your mother!
description.id: Beberapa tahun yang lalu, mantan pacar saya, yang saya putuskan setelah hubungan cinta satu malam kami, datang mengunjungi saya sebagai seorang bangsawan. Dia bilang dia menyesal telah meninggalkanku. Apa yang kamu bicarakan? Apa yang perlu disesali ketika kita telah berpisah dengan mudah? Selain itu, saya pikir dia bahkan salah paham dengan putri kakak perempuan saya sebagai putri kami. "Aku tidak tahu. Aku tidak tahu kalau kamu membesarkan anak kita sendirian." Situasi apa ini? Saat itu, keponakan perempuan saya, yang menyembunyikan diri di belakang punggung saya, menjulurkan lidahnya ke arahnya. "Aku benci kamu, kamu orang jahat yang meninggalkan kami. Pergilah!" Dia terhuyung-huyung karena terkejut. Tidak, dia tidak meninggalkanmu. Dan aku bukan ibumu!

날 버렸던 걸 후회한다면서.
정작 이별 통보한 사람은 전데요?!

와중에 언니 대신 키우고 있는 5살 조카, 하나엘을 보고 이상한 오해를 시작한다.

"전혀 몰랐어. 시에라 네가, 우리의 아이를 혼자 키우고 있었을 줄은…."

설상가상으로 숨어있던 하나엘은
저리 가라며 카시어스를 향해 소리치는 것이 아닌가?

"제발 부정하지 말아줘… 우리의 관계도, 아이도."
"나쁜 아저씨! 우릴 버렸으면서!"

아니야, 저 사람은 너 안 버렸어.
그리고 난 네 엄마가 아니라고!

Soon, fate brings Eremia into the palace and she's forced to serve as his royal musician. They bond over their shared love of Istania's lore, but the threat of a devastating war looms on the horizon. Will Eremia be forced to watch the nation burn, as history repeats itself? And will Rajid realize that even a caged songbird longs to be free?

Ils vont alors se rapprocher grâce à leur amour pour Istania et la possibilité d'une future guerre dévastatrice menaçant de réduire ces terres à néant. Emeria sera-t-elle contrainte de voir l'Histoire se répéter et réduire la nation d'Istania en cendres? Rajid réalisera-t-il que même les beaux oiseaux chanteurs retenus captifs ont besoin de liberté?

description.en: “What am I? As the dog that stays by your side”. The youngest son of the Chairman of one of the leading business groups in the country, Cheng Shi Yan, has been growing up in a warm family. Until, one day he loses his parents in a sudden fire, and his only brother goes mad. When his whole world is crashing down on him, however, the Vice Chairman, Shou He Fu, appears as Shi Yan’s guardian. In order to protect his family and his only brother, Shi Yan chooses to become Shou He’s puppet…But on his twentieth birthday, he receives a letter saying, “ I’ll help you escape.” As if bewitched by the promise of freedom, he visits the address mentioned in the letter, only to meet a mysterious man, Li Xian, who offers to be his master?

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 乙一

**Real Name:** Adachi Hirotaka (安達寛高)

Writer, screenwriter, and film director. Born October 21, 1978, in Tanushimaru (now part of Kurume), Fukuoka Prefecture. He graduated from Tanushimaru's Kawakai Primary and Secondary Schools.

A multifaceted and shy artist, Adachi Hirotaka has a love of video games, manga, anime, and movies. As a teenager, he was overweight and bullied at school, but through Dance Dance Revolution and a proper diet, he lost 20 kilograms, going from 85 to 65 kg.

Inspired by his early reading, particularly mystery novels, he began writing his first novel at 16 while attending Kurume National College from 1994 to 1999. He attempted to enter the Fujimi Prize for Novel with a fantasy novel, but was unsuccessful. In 1996, however, he won the 6th JUMP Novel Grand Prize from Shueisha, making his debut with Natsu to Hanabi to Watashi no Shitai (Summer, Fireworks, and My Corpse), published by JUMP j-BOOKS and illustrated by Hataji Hideaki. Judge Kurimoto Kaoru strongly recommended the work. He later transferred to Toyohashi University of Technology, where he studied ecological engineering.

In 2003, he placed third in the Honkaku Mystery Awards. His early work focused largely on short stories and light novels, of which he became a strong advocate. GOTH: Tenohira Jiken was particularly well received and won the Honkaku Mystery Award. His early fiction was broadly divided into horror novels ("Kuro Otsuichi") and sad stories ("Shiro Otsuichi"). Under the name Otsuichi, he has mainly published with Shueisha, Kadokawa Shoten (now KADOKAWA), and Gentosha.

In 2004, his editor invited him to audition for Oshii Mamoru's film Innocence. There he met Oshii Tomoe, the director's daughter, whom he married in 2006.

Adachi Hirotaka has also written under several pseudonyms. In 2005, he published ghost stories under the name Yamashiro Asako in Media Factory's magazine Yu. He also wrote romance fiction as Nakata Eiichi for a Shodensha romance anthology and the magazine Feel Love. He deliberately fabricated biographical information for these identities, but revealed on Twitter on June 30, 2011, that he had been working under both names.

In November 2012, the Mainichi Shimbun reported on the Nakata Eiichi pseudonym after Kuchibiru ni Uta o, written under that name, was selected for the Shogakukan Children's Publishing Culture Award. In 2010, he had also participated in Makai Tantei Meiosei O, a project in which eight writers concealed their identities and each wrote a book under the name Echizen Mataro.

Under his real name, Adachi Hirotaka has directed independent films. In 2004, Gōsuto wa Shōsetsuka ga Suki was selected for the 5th Takarazuka Film Festival and Video Contest, and he made four more works through around 2015.

In 2016, Otsuichi, Nakata Eiichi, Yamashiro Asako, and Echizen Mataro published the short-story collection Kill Mary Sue, with commentary by Adachi Hirotaka, bringing his major aliases together. He also revealed that he had contributed a film essay under the previously unknown alias Yuushi Pillow. The May 2016 issue of Da Vinci featured a discussion between his three principal aliases under the title "A Miraculous Talk Was Made."

His style has influenced authors such as Tomoi Hitsuji, who received recognition in the 2012 Kono Mystery ga Sugoi! rankings and has cited Otsuichi as a fan. He is also close friends with authors Sadakane Shinji and Matsubara Makoto; after traveling to Turkey with Adachi, the three co-wrote Toruko o Ryokō-shi.

Married to Oshii Tomoe, daughter of Oshii Mamoru. They had their first child in 2010.

Friends with Sadakane Shinji and Matsubara Makoto.

description.en:
After my grandmother's funeral, I woke up in the body of a noblewoman. Specifically, a woman who had died because she didn’t want to get married.

The older brother of the man she was supposed to marry comes to me, threatening to pay off her debts, and my father is absolutely no help at all.
On top of that, the shop is about to disappear, and the estate is falling apart.
Just yesterday, I was a modern person finding small joys like sneaking a coffee from the break room or charging my phone at the office, but now I have to pay off debts and manage an estate.
I tried to live a good life, just as the god had said when he gave me this chance…
"I wonder if selling a few loaves of bread will really help you pay it back."
"Don't worry, I'll pay it off."
"If such a miracle happens."
He turned to me, standing slightly askew with his arms crossed over his chest. Even in his anger, he looked astonishingly handsome.
"If that miracle occurs, I'll kneel before you and kiss the top of your foot."

---
Grandma said that good things come to those who live honestly, but my life ended in some car accident. Luckily, I was given a second chance to live an upright life! And so I found myself in the body of Everdeen Usher, a woman who fled home to avoid marrying into a ducal house. Wait, I’m a noble?! Oh crap, my fiancé’s older brother is demanding I pay back the dowry my useless father took! With all the odds against me, can I live an honest life and reach a different ending this time?

description.en:
[Promotional oneshot for the novel.]

I’d been reincarnated as the heroine of a predictable third-rate harem novel. I decided to live as the heroine and enjoy my comfortable life with the hero… but what kind of romance is this?! Having a soldier for a boyfriend, there was a constant stream of women surrounding him… and all kinds of incidents occurred. So now I was trying my best to live a normal life. I broke up with my boyfriend and married a man I’d met during a blind date but… What? My husband is the demon king?

“Ha, what do you have your guard up for? Are you scared that I’m going to do something to you? I can see that you’re scared.”

“Why would I be scared?”

“What?”

“What would you be able to do to me? Don’t flatter yourself, I’m just uncomfortable.”

“I want you to be mine, but that seems to be impossible.”

…No matter how much I think about this, everything seems to be wrong.
description.ru: Я перевоплотилась в героиню предсказуемого третьесортного гаремного романа. Так что я порвала со своим парнем, пошла на свидание вслепую, вышла замуж за того парня со свидания и… что? Он оказался Королем Демонов? Так я вышла замуж за короля демонов.

description.en:
One day, “Shin Jinho” and his colleagues fell to another world due to a sudden earthquake… It turned out that that world was the same as the webtoon drawn by his older brother.

His brother was a long-time unknown artist who was frustrated by a series of failures in his next work, was pessimistic about his work, and disappeared somewhere… Only Jinho, who knows his brother’s webtoon worldview and story well, can properly conquer this otherworld.

As a result, Jinho goes on a journey with his colleagues to try to kill two birds with a stone as they attempt to escape from this world to return to their original world, and to find out his missing brother’s whereabouts.

Being a medical student, what is the authenticity of a medical student?  
  
Jang Joon Hyuk, a ex-mechanical engineering student, feels like a boomer around all the freshmen when he goes back to medical school!

When I opened my eyes, I thought it was going to be the common cliché of 'Transmigrating into a webnovel's world as the main character', but this story hadn't been written. The life of the main character Lee Hwan, the setting, the other characters. None of it!

God—the author—told me, "My style of writing webnovels is going to be very different from how your people do it."

Wait a second! This is way too different!!!
description.pt-br:
Quando abri meus olhos, pensei que estava em mais um clichê de “Transmigrar para o mundo de uma webnovel sendo o protagonista”, mas essa história não foi escrita. A vida do protagonista Lee Hwan, todo o roteiro, história e outros personagens não foram escritos, absolutamente nada foi escrito!!

Deus, o autor, me falou, “Meu estilo de escrita em webnovel é bem diferente do jeito que as pessoas fazem.”

description.en:
Eveness wakes up as the wicked princess of a novel who's doomed to die on her wedding day. Determined to change her destiny, she rebuilds her reputation and convinces her cold fiancé Grand Duke Terence Lenz into a partnership to prevent this impending peril. However, as she alters the story, unexpected twists arise—Terence’s hatred turns to passionate love, and new dangers loom. Can Eveness navigate this altered fate and find true happiness, or will the unknown challenges consume her?
___
A villainess with 44 days left to live. 

I've possessed the princess Eve. I have a limited life span, but I cannot die in vain. I stopped committing evil deeds in order to survive, and I succeeded in making a deal with my fiancé who hated me. 

Why does the crisis never stop? 

On top of that, the mastermind (*contract fiancé) who was supposed to be my business partner has started to obsess over me, and the male lead suddenly wants to protect me, leaving the female lead behind? I just wanted to live… 

Where did this world go wrong? 
___
She wakes up as Princess Ivnes von Albion, a notorious villainess destined to be killed.

But dying a meaningless death? No way. She decides to stop her vicious behavior and even manages to strike a deal with the fiancé who once despised her.

So why does the danger keep coming?

Now the supposed “business-only” contract fiancé, who’s actually the hidden mastermind, starts obsessing over her. And the original male lead suddenly wants to protect her instead of the heroine?

All she wanted was to survive.. Where did this world start to go wrong?
description.ko:
죽음을 44일 앞둔 악녀. 
황녀 이브로 빙의했다.

살해당할 시한부 인생이지만,
이대로 허무하게 죽을 순 없지.

살기 위해 패악질을 멈추고,
나를 혐오하던 약혼자와 거래도 성공했는데.

왜 위기는 멈추지 않는 거지?

게다가 동업자일 뿐이라던 흑막(*계약 약혼자)은 내게 집착하기 시작하고, 
남주는 갑자기 여주를 놔두고 날 지키겠다고?

살고 싶었을 뿐인데…
이 세계, 어디서부터 뒤틀린 거야?
description.pl: Zła kobieta z 44 dniami do śmierci. Odzyskałam przytomność jako księżniczka Eve. Choć mam wyznaczony czas do śmierci, nie mogę po prostu umrzeć w tak bezsensowny sposób. Aby przeżyć, przestałam zachowywać się jak potwór i udało mi się nawet zawrzeć układ z narzeczonym, który mnie nienawidził. Dlaczego więc zagrożenia wciąż się nie kończą? Na dodatek czarny charakter (mój narzeczony na podstawie kontraktu), który miał być tylko wspólnikiem, zaczyna obsesyjnie się mną interesować, a główny bohater nagle zostawia główną bohaterkę i twierdzi, że musi mnie chronić? Chciałam tylko przeżyć… Od czego to wszystko się tak pokręciło?
description.ru:
Я очнулась в теле принцессы по имени Ив, злодейки, до смерти которой осталось всего 44 дня.
Жизнь у неё была жестокая и полная страданий,
но просто так сдаться и умереть — не вариант.

Ради выживания я отказалась от мести и даже заключила сделку с тем, кто меня презирает. Всё вроде бы шло по плану…
Но почему беды не заканчиваются?
К тому же, жених по договору, с которым всё должно было быть формально, вдруг начинает проявлять ко мне странный интерес, а герой, который когда-то оставил настоящую главную героиню, вдруг говорит, что теперь хочет защищать меня?

Я ведь просто хотела выжить…
С какого момента этот мир так перевернулся?
description.pt-br:
"Uma princesa condenada à morte tenta mudar seu destino, mas acaba reescrevendo também o coração de seu noivo."

Eveness desperta no corpo da cruel princesa de uma novel, destinada a morrer no dia do próprio casamento. Decidida a mudar seu destino, ela reconstrói sua reputação e convence seu frio noivo, o grão-duque Terence Lenz, a formar uma aliança para evitar essa tragédia. Mas, à medida que altera o curso da história, surgem consequências inesperadas: o ódio de Terence se transforma em um amor intenso, e novos perigos começam a aparecer. Será que Eveness conseguirá enfrentar esse destino reescrito e encontrar a felicidade, ou acabará sendo consumida pelos desafios que ela mesma criou?

Ten-year-old Celine Mars dreams of becoming a great knight escort just like her father. She’s set to serve under Damien Willow, the heir of a powerful Duke. There’s only one problem—he’s a total weakling, or so she thinks. Celine vows to train the poor, defenseless Damien to stand up for himself, completely unaware of his real strength. description.en: The first life is a modern office worker who died from overwork. The second was a noble but burned down overnight. Marriage, which I thought was a golden Dong-A line, was married to a indecisive playboy husband. Having suffered an accident without revenge, it was a dog's death. Avella, the woman who experienced these two failures. My third birthday, this time, I'm going back to my wedding day! After a splendid wedding ceremony, giving bamboo bread to her ex-husband, who has no principles and is indecisive, she opens a dessert house with her long-cherished dream and specialty. Can this dessert shop succeed in the interference of my previous life husband and mother-in-law, who are now strangers but do not know why they keep coming?

在經歷兩世的失敗後，第三次阿貝拉帶著自己第一世的廚藝開了一家甜品店，儘管作為落魄貴族的她現在的名聲不是特別好。

description.en: Can love transcend all boundaries? The 200-year-long peace in Mokrin’s island tribe is broken when the warlike Fiendbloods arrive to demand open borders. What’s more, Eonyeong, the son of their chieftess, falls hopelessly in love with Mokrin. Now it’s up to her — will she spurn his affection or marry him for the sake of her people?

Cha In-woo, a shy student with zero presence, becomes partners with Kwak Ha-jun, who looks exactly like his favorite game character. While Cha In-woo is excited to bond with him while working on homework assigned by his teacher, Cha In-woo suddenly finds himself drawn into a cruel bet by Kwak Ha-jun...

A heartwarming romantic comedy between two high school students!
description.ko: 소심하고 존재감도 없는 차인우는 새 학기 낯선 친구들 사이 최애와 똑 닮은 곽하준과 짝꿍이 된다. 마침, 선생님이 내준 숙제를 함께하며 친해질 생각에 들떠있던 차인우는 별안간 곽하준의 심술궂은 내기에 걸려드는데…. 두 고등학생의 우당탕 풋풋한 러브코미디!

description.ar:
في عالم تظهر فيه البوابات فجاة وتخرج منها الوحوش، يعيش الصياد يون مينجون مثقلا بالذنب بعد وفاة حبيبته جونغ سيا في حادثة اختراق بوابة.

وبعد عام كامل من موتها، وفي ذكرى وفاتها، تحدث كارثة جديدة عند قبرها… لكن ما يخرج من البوابة هذه المرة ليس وحشا، بل سيا نفسها.

لقد عادت حبيبته التي ظن انها ماتت، لكن ليس كما كانت؛ فقد اصبحت تنينا، اقوى كائن حي، وبعد ان قضت زمنا طويلا تبحث عن وسيلة للعودة اليه، لم يعد يشغلها سوى شيء واحد: البقاء الى جانب مينجون… والتاكد من انه لم يجد حبيبة اخرى في غيابها.
description.en:
In a world where gates suddenly appear and monsters emerge from them, hunter Yoon Min-jun lives burdened by guilt after losing his girlfriend, Jung Si-a, in a gate break incident.

One year after her death, on the anniversary of the tragedy, another disaster occurs at her grave… but this time, what emerges from the gate is not a monster.

It is Si-a herself.

The girlfriend he thought was dead has returned, but no longer as the person he once knew. She has become a dragon, the strongest living creature, and after spending an unimaginably long time searching for a way back to him, she now wants only one thing: to stay by Min-jun’s side… and make sure he did not find another girlfriend while she was gone.

description.en:
When an average twenty-something wakes up in the battered body of a nameless extra from a romance novel, all she wants is to go home. But first, she’ll have to see the story through as Rona, the maid of Grand Duke Ileon, the novel’s hero who was blinded by poison. She just has to make sure the heroine restores his sight with a special flower so they can have their happy ending -- easy enough, right? With a plot gone awry, Rona’s dangerous past, and the grand duke’s affections, can Rona stick to the story?
___
*Unexpectedly, I grabbed the collar of the blind beast.*

Grand Duke Eléon Clevent fell into the abyss from the Empire’s Greatest Knight. Rona succeeded in making Eléon, who is obsessed with anger and frustration, into a human being again. Soon after, Rona found her family and left his side… When the Grand Duke’s eyes were healed, he was desperately searching for her through the entire empire.

“Young Lady, have we met somewhere?”

“It’s my first time meeting you, Your Highness.”
description.fr: Et si la seule façon de rentrer chez vous était d’assister au dénouement d’un récit dont vous n'avez gardé qu'un vague souvenir? Yoon-ji, 27 ans, se réveille un jour dans la peau de Rona, simple figurante d’une histoire qu’elle avait à peine lue. Coincée dans ce rôle effacé, elle doit guider le récit jusqu’à sa fin si elle veut retrouver sa véritable existence. Sa mission paraît simple: rapprocher le grand-duc Iléon, rendu aveugle par un poison, de Karina, l’héroïne destinée à lui rendre la vue. Mais rien ne se déroule comme prévu. Les protagonistes n'en font qu'à leur tête et l’histoire commence à changer. Plus Yoon-ji essaie de remettre les choses en place, plus tout s’éloigne de la version originale. Parviendra-t-elle à ramener l’histoire à son cours initial, ou devra-t-elle inventer une fin inédite, quitte à tout perdre, y compris son retour chez elle?
description.id: Grand Duke sekaligus Kesatria terhebat kekaisaran, Ileon Clevent, kehilangan penglihatannya akibat perang dan mengalami depresi akut. Namun, berkat kemunculan pelayan baru bernama Rona, Ileon berhasil bangkit dan menjalani kehidupannya lagi. Rona juga mencoba untuk memulihkan penglihatan Ileon, tetapi di tengah prosesnya, dia menemukan identitas aslinya dan kembali tinggal bersama keluarganya tanpa sempat berpamitan dengan Ileon. Saat Ileon mendapatkan penglihatannya kembali, dia pun menjelajahi kekaisaran demi menemukan Rona. Apakah Ileon akan berhasil menemukan Rona dengan identitas aslinya?
description.ko:

'로나'는 좌절에 사로잡힌 일레온을 다시 사람 구실하게 만드는 데 성공한다. 

얼마 후, 로나는 가족을 찾게 되고 그의 곁을 떠나는데… 
믿을 수 없게도 눈을 뜬 일레온은 그녀를 찾기 위해 제국을 샅샅이 뒤지고 있었다. 

“영애. 우리 어디서 만난 적 없나?” 
“초면입니다. 대공 전하.” 

짐승은 함부로 거두는 거 아니라던데, 목줄을 잡고 있던 짐승이 내 목에 기어코 입술을 가져다 대었다.

Роне удалось снова превратить Элеона, одержимого гневом и разочарованием, в человека. Вскоре после этого Рона нашла свою семью и ушла от него... Когда глаза великого князя исцелились, он отчаянно искал ее по всей империи.
description.th: ข้าดันไปคว้าสายจูงของอสูรตาบอดโดยไม่ตั้งใจซะแล้ว แกรนด์ดยุกอิลเลออน เคลเวนต์ ตกลงไปในเหวลึกด้วยน้ำมือของอัศวินผู้ยิ่งใหญ่แห่งจักรวรรดิ และเขาก็ได้พบกับโรนา หญิงสาวที่ทำให้เขาผู้เกรี้ยวกราดและขุ่นมัวได้กลับมาเป็นมนุษย์อีกครั้ง หลังจากนั้นไม่นาน โรนาก็ได้พบกับครอบครวของเธอและจากเขาไป… เมื่อดวงตาของแกรนด์ดยุกกลับมามองเห็นได้ปกติ เขาจึงออกตามหาโรนาไปทั่วทั้งจักรวรรดิอย่างเอาเป็นเอาตายโดยหวังที่จะได้พบเธออีกครั้ง "แม่สาวน้อย เราเคยพบกันมาก่อนหรือไม่?" description.zh-hk: 看到故事結局，就能回到原來的世界。 轉生的露娜成功地讓在戰爭中失去視力，並放棄人生的「盲獸」伊萊昂·克萊本特重新恢復了人性。但露娜也已提前悄然離去。重見光明後，伊萊昂這位曾經的帝國最強騎士，發誓要尋回那個讓他重生的女人。 「初次見面，大公殿下。」然而，事情似乎並不如他所希望的那樣順利…

title.en: The Hero Went Crazy Even Though I'm the One Who Died (Promo)

altTitles.ko: 죽은 건 난데 용사님이 미쳐 버렸다

description.en:
As the hero's comrade, I died after blocking him from the evil dragon's breath.

Well, it's fine.

Hero Elkinas was the only friend I trusted to have my back.

I'll go out with a bang, I guess, so the hero can marry a pretty woman and live the rest of his life.

…Is what I thought would happen, but after 80 years passed, I came back to life in a completely different body.

And…

“It’s regrettable, Arlene. Elkinas went insane. Completely insane.”

That was the first thing I heard.

*

What else could I do? I need to help my close friend who seems to have not been able to accept my death, so I decided to stay by his side while hiding my identity.

This way he could completely accept the past and become happy, which is why I died for him.

But… I think he recognized me.

"You… You're Arlene, aren't you?"

I touched my face. I definitely don't look like Arlene. Shouldn't there be no way he could know who I was?

"I won't ever let you go… Ever," Elkinas said with shining eyes.
description.ko:
나는 용사의 동료로, 용사를 대신해 마룡의 브레스를 맞고 죽었다.


뭐, 괜찮다. 
용사 엘키나스는 내 등을 믿고 맡길 수 있는 유일한 친구였다.
용사님이 멋진 여성과 결혼해서 여생을 보낼 수 있게 친구인 내가 대신 멋지게 눈을 감지 뭐.
…라고 생각했는데.

80년이 지난 뒤, 나는 완전히 새로운 몸으로 되살아났다. 

그런데…

"유감이군. 아렌느. 엘키나스는 미쳤다. 아주 제대로 미쳤어."

처음으로 들은 소식이 이따위다.

*

어쩔 수 있겠어? 도와줘야지. 
내 죽음을 받아들이지 못하는 것 같은 친우를 돕기 위해
내 정체를 숨긴 채 그의 곁에 남기로 했다.

엘키나스가 온전히 과거를 받아들이고 행복해지기를, 
그게 내가 그를 위해 죽은 이유였으니까.

하지만… 그가 나를 알아보는 것 같다. 

"너. …아렌느지."

나는 내 얼굴을 매만졌다. 분명 내 얼굴은 아렌느가 아닌데.
알아볼 리가 없어야 하는 거 아냐? 

"절대로 놓치지 않을거야. …절대로."

엘키나스가 눈을 빛내며 말했다.

죽음을 받아들이려던 그때, 그에게 알 수 없는 능력이 개화된다.
그것은 기억의 ‘계승’.

I realized it was love the moment that person left.  
  
Hiding their feelings for each other, Sehyuk and Yina, who were just friends, eventually end their ambiguous relationship and part ways. Eight years later, Sehyuk, who hears about Yina’s engagement, realizes that he hasn’t moved on… Youthful days that can’t be reversed, a romance of two people who had to live resisting their strong attraction towards each other.

"All my people are dead... I just wanted to try my best. I just wanted to be a kind Empress. Why..."

Her injuries made her look so worn out… After torturing her for days and killing everyone she ever loved, the Emperor abandoned the Empress in the snowy mountains. In this heavy snowfall, the former Empress Roselyn had resigned herself and was ready to accept death. Her family, her friends, all her hard work for the people of the empire... There was no reason left for her to continue living. So she laid down on this pure white blanket, her body almost frozen, and watched the white snow be dyed in black. At first, the cold was painful, but the pain quickly subsided and so she thought that freezing to death just might not be all that bad.

“Being persecuted to death, lying alone as if you're ruling this snowy field...”

That man.

“If you don't need your life anymore... then pardon me, I’ll take it.”

He's the enemy general, Tamon Krasis.

“You’re mine now, Empress.”

She was abandoned by them, but he stole her and took her away. Who kidnapped the Empress?

description.pt-br:
"Todo o meu pessoal está morto... Eu só queria dar o meu melhor. Eu só queria ser uma boa Imperatriz. Por quê..."

Suas feridas a fizeram parecer desgastada… Depois de torturá-la por dias e matar todos que ela amava, o Imperador abandonou a Imperatriz nas montanhas nevadas. Em uma tempestade de neve, a antiga Imperatriz Roselyn havia desistido e aceitado a morte. Sua família, seus amigos, todo o seu trabalho duro pelo povo do Império... Não havia mais motivo para ela continuar viva. Então ela deitou naquele lençol alvo, seu corpo quase congelado, e observou a neve branca ser tingida de preto. A princípio, o frio era doloroso, mas a dor amenizou rapidamente e então ela pensou que congelar até a morte talvez não fosse tão ruim.

“Ser perseguida até a morte, deitada sozinha, como se estivesse reinando sobre este campo nevado...”

Esse homem.

“Se não quer mais a sua vida... Então me dê licença, irei tomá-la.”

Ele é o general inimigo, Tamon Krasis.

“Você é minha agora, Imperatriz.”

Ela foi abandonado por eles, mas ele a roubou e levou. Quem sequestrou a Imperatriz?

description.en:
My name is Leonora Hachania. Although I’m the daughter of a villain extra whose name in itself means ‘insignificant’, my desire for power is unimaginable. I can’t just let the Hachania family be as insignificant as it is in the original novel! 

“Woll to the left, wight now!” 
“Yes, ma’am!” 
“Woll to the wight, wight now!” 
“Yes, ma’am!” 

With the sunglasses I made by painting on them with ink, I raised my voice fiercely. 

“Sowldier Enoch, we don’t cwy!” The tender-hearted third child who had met my eyes was startled and sniffled with his runny nose. 

“W-we don’t cry!” I’ve succeeded. 
“Were you originally this weak? How annoying.” 
“Ugh! S-Save me!” 
“Hyung, they look like they’re really suffering, should we kill them quickly? It would be better for them.” 

My brothers who couldn’t even hold a candle to the male lead and were extras have become the greatest villain brothers in the world! 

Although it was a bit difficult since my villain father was so clumsy, “Rini, just what kind of evil deed are you planning this time…”
“Keke, it’s nothing. As expected of my daughter, you’re planning something evil. Very nice.”

I’ve redesigned him to be a villain with a dual personality. Keke, mwahaha! Nice, I’ve increased our assets using the information from the original novel and made the family into a significant one! Now, I just need to escape this terminally ill body and enjoy the proper life of a villainess- 

“I know that Your Ladyship is a caring person, so it would be too greedy to wish for your kindness to be mine alone.” 

I think the human weapon that I revived for the family has broken.

“But if I get rid of all the people you are kind to…” The red flame blazing in his hand burned the map of the world. “Won’t I be the only you can be kind to?” He says that as if he’s about to hunt down the entire world.

“실시!”

“실시!”

잉크를 칠해 만든 선글라스를 뽐내며 나는 바락바락 목청을 높였다.

“에노끄 훈뇬병, 울지 안씀미다!”

나와 눈이 마주친 마음 약한 셋째가 찔끔 놀라 삐죽 나온 콧물을 들이켠다.

“우, 울지 않습니다!”

성공했다.

“원래 이렇게 약했던 건가? 쓰레기같군.”
“크억! 사, 살려줘!”

남주 콧김에도 날아가는 촛불 엑스트라였던 오빠들이 세계관 최고 악당 형제가 되었다!

어설픈 악당 아빠가 살짝 난관이었지만,

“리니, 또 무슨 악독한 짓을 계획하고 있는 것이냐…….”

이중인격 빌런으로 개조시켰다.

쿠쿡. 움화화!

좋아. 원작 정보를 이용해 재산도 불렸겠다, 가문도 하찮지 않게 만들었겠다!
빨리 시한부 육체를 탈피해 제대로된 빌런의 삶을 즐겨 보려고 했는데-

“공녀가 다정한 사람이라는 거, 알고 있습니다. 그러니 내게만 상냥하길 바라는 건 욕심이겠죠.”

아무래도 가문을 위해 부활시킨 인간 병기가 조금 고장 난 것 같다.

“하지만 상냥해질 대상이 없어지면…….”

그의 손에서 피어오른 새빨간 불꽃이 세계 지도를 불태웠다.

“나에게만 상냥해질 수도 있지 않을까요?”

description.pt-br:
Meu nome é Leonora Khachania. Ela é filha de um vilão extra menor, mas tem um grande desejo de poder.

Não podemos deixar o Haagenia tão insignificante quanto o original!

"Esquerda, Cloudy, foca!"

"Faça!"

"Direita, Cloudy!"

"Faça!"

Exibindo um óculos de sol feito com tinta, levantei minha voz.

"ENOQUE, chore!"

A terceira criança, que tinha um contato visual fraco comigo, ficou surpresa e engoliu o choro.

"Woo, eu não vou chorar!"

* * *

Sucesso.

"Era para ser tão fraco? É como lixo."

"Gasp! M-me salve!"

"Irmão, por que você não o mata rapidamente, porque isso parece ser o melhor para ele."

Os irmãos mais velhos, que eram extras frouxos, se tornaram os melhores irmãos vilões do mundo!

O desajeitado pai vilão foi um desafio.

"Lini, o que mais você está planejando fazer..."

"Haha, não importa. Você está planejando algo maldoso como minha filha. Muito bem."

Foi convertido em um vilão de dupla personalidade.

Kekeke. Mwahaha.

Boa. Você deve ter usado as informações originais para aumentar sua riqueza e tornar sua família insignificante! Tentei escapar do limite de tempo e aproveitar a vida de um verdadeiro vilão—

"Eu sei que uma princesa é uma pessoa amigável. Então é ganância querer que você seja doce apenas comigo."

Acho que a arma humana revivida para a família está um pouco quebrada.

"Mas quando não há ninguém para ser gentil..."

A chama vermelha brilhante de sua mão queimou o mapa-múndi.

"Eu acho que você pode ser gentil comigo?"

description.en:
"I want to bring it back… Our original form, our original Michael..."

Evangeline and Michael grew up together on the island since childhood. However, her friend Michael left the island to become a knight and lost contact with him. When was it wrong? Five years later, she and Michael met again and he had become a cursed magician who burned the continent.

"Me… I can't remember anything, Eve."

"What do you mean?"

"I… I've been cursed by a demonic dragon."

The evil dragon's curse turned the boy with an angel's name into a slaughter-crazy demon. The boy's most precious person, Evangeline, made a decision.

"I will choose you this time. Mika."

The story of Michael, who became a magician under the curse of a demonic dragon, and Evangeline, who tries to save Michael.

---
How far are you willing to go for love? Not a day goes by that Eve doesn't wish to reunite with her childhood friend, Mikha. But three years later, when she learns that Mikha has become a cursed sorcerer who leaves only death in his wake, Eve must embark on a journey to save not only the man she loves but also the world as she knows it.

---
***Note:** The webtoon was released as R15; its not R19 like the novel.*
description.es:
¿Qué tan lejos estás dispuesto a ir por amor?
No hay ni un solo día en el que Eva no desee reunirse con su amigo de la infancia, Mikael. Pero más tarde, cuando se entera de que Mikael posee una maldición que deja solo muerte a su paso, Eva se embarca en un viaje para salvar no solo al hombre que ama, sino también al mundo tal como lo conoce.
description.fr:
«Je veux le ramener... Notre forme originale, notre Michael original...»

Evangeline et Michael ont grandi ensemble sur l'île depuis l'enfance. Cependant, son ami Michael a quitté l'île pour devenir chevalier et a perdu le contact avec elle. Depuis quand c'était mal? Cinq ans plus tard, elle rencontre à nouveau Michael et il devient un magicien maudit qui brûle le continent.

«Moi… Je ne me souviens de rien, Eve.»
«Que veux-tu dire?»
«Je… j'ai été maudit par un dragon démoniaque.»

La malédiction du dragon maléfique a transformé le garçon avec le nom de l'ange en un démon fou de massacre. La personne la plus précieuse du garçon, Evangeline, prend une décision.

«Je vais te choisir cette fois. Mika.»

L'histoire de Michael, devenu magicien sous la malédiction d'un dragon démoniaque, et d'Evangeline, qui tente de sauver Michael.

---
Jusqu'où iriez-vous par amour?

Pas un jour ne s'écoule sans qu'Ève ne rêve d'être réunie avec Mikha, son ami d'enfance. Mais cinq ans plus tard, lorsqu'elle apprend que Mikha est devenu un sorcier maudit, Ève doit s'embarquer dans un périple pour sauver non seulement l'homme qu'elle aime, mais également le monde qui est le sien.
description.id: “Aku ingin mengembalikannya… Bentuk asli kita, Michael asli kita… .” Evangeline dan Michael tumbuh bersama di pulau itu sejak kecil. Namun, temannya Michael meninggalkan pulau itu untuk menjadi seorang ksatria dan kehilangan kontak dengannya. Kapan itu salah? Lima tahun kemudian, Michael bertemu lagi dan menjadi pesulap terkutuk yang membakar benua. "Aku... aku tidak ingat apa-apa, Eve." "Apa maksudmu?" "Aku... aku telah dikutuk oleh naga iblis." Kutukan naga jahat mengubah anak laki-laki dengan nama malaikat itu menjadi iblis penggila pembantaian. Orang yang paling berharga bagi bocah itu, Evangeline, membuat keputusan. “Aku akan memilihmu kali ini. Mika.” Kisah Michael, yang menjadi pesulap di bawah kutukan naga iblis, dan Evangeline, yang mencoba menyelamatkan Michael.
description.it:

저주로 인해 마술사가 된 상처 남주 미카엘 x 그런 미카엘의 저주를 풀고자 성장하는 여기사 에반젤린의 감동적인 모험물. 

“되돌려 놓고 싶어… 원래의 우리 모습, 원래의 미카엘로….” 

어린 시절부터 섬에서 함께 자란 에반젤린과 미카엘. 
그러나 친구였던 미카엘은 기사가 되겠다고 섬을 떠난 후 연락이 끊겼다. 

언제부터 잘못 된 것이었을까? 
삼 년의 시간이 지난 후, 다시 만난 미카엘은 대륙을 불태우고 다니는 저주받은 마술사가 되어 있었다. 

“나… 아무것도 기억이 안 나, 이브.” 
“그게 무슨 말이야?” 
“난… 마룡의 저주에 걸렸어.” 

사악한 용의 저주는 천사의 이름을 가진 소년을 살육에 미친 악마로 만들었다. 
그런 소년의 가장 소중한 사람, 에반젤린은 결심한다. 

“이번엔 너를 선택할 거야. 미카.” 

마룡의 저주를 받아 마술사가 된 미카엘과, 그런 미카엘을 구하려는 에반젤린의 모험 이야기.

Однако проклятие демонического дракона Баракиуса поглотило его...

“我想把它帶回來……我們原來的樣子，我們原來的邁克爾……” 伊萬潔琳和邁克爾從小一起在島上長大。

然而，他的朋友邁克爾離開小島成為一名騎士，並與他失去了聯繫。

從什麼時候開始錯了？ 五年後，邁克爾再次相遇，成為燃燒大陸的詛咒魔法師。

“我……我什麼都不記得了，伊芙。” “你是什麼意思？” “我……我被魔龍詛咒了。”

惡龍的詛咒將這個有著天使之名的男孩變成了嗜殺成性的惡魔。

男孩最珍貴的人伊萬潔琳做出了決定。

description.en: Young Claire lives with her mother and her twin sister in a humble country home. Feeling mature for her age, Claire is tired of being different from everyone she's ever met. However, when her father suddenly appears, she realizes that she wasn't the only "strange" one in the family. As she slowly learns about her family's past, she understands more about herself and her destiny.
description.fr: Dans un monde où sont tombés du ciel des Astariols, demi-dieux envoyés pour lutter contre le mal, la petite Claire est une enfant dont la maturité d'esprit et les pouvoirs surnaturels la démarquent des autres enfants de son âge. Elle vit avec sa sœur jumelle Rashel et sa mère Charlotte, de village en village au fil de leurs déménagements inopinés. Mais tout change lorsque le duc Arshel Constantine Disandos débarque subitement dans leur vie.
description.ja:
普通の子どもとはどこか違う「クレール」は
双子の「イシエル」と母の「シャーロット」と共に暮らしていた。

そんな彼女が９歳になった春。
突然、存在すらも知らなかった父が目の前に現れた…！

「静かに暮らしていたのにどうして今になって訪ねてきたの？セルシアス公爵閣下」
「でしたらもうそろそろ賑やかになってもいい頃合いでは？」

…誰か2人の関係を説明してくれない？
description.pl: Młoda Claire mieszka z matką i siostrą bliźniaczką w skromnym wiejskim domu. Czując się dojrzałą jak na swój wiek, Claire jest zmęczona byciem inną od wszystkich, których kiedykolwiek spotkała. Jednak kiedy nagle pojawia się jej ojciec, zdaje sobie sprawę, że nie była jedyną "dziwną" osobą w rodzinie. W miarę jak powoli poznaje przeszłość swojej rodziny, rozumie więcej o sobie i swoim przeznaczeniu.
description.ru: Юная Клэр живет со своей матерью и сестрой-близнецом в скромном загородном доме. Чувствуя себя взрослой для своего возраста, Клэр устала отличаться от всех, кого она когда-либо встречала. Однако, когда внезапно появляется ее отец, она понимает, что была не единственной «странной» в семье. По мере того, как она постепенно узнает о прошлом своей семьи, она больше понимает себя и свою судьбу.
description.zh-hk: 九歲那年春天，原本以為已經消失的人——爸爸，竟然出現了。 「為什麼來找我？不用見到你，我過得很好。」 「既然如此，殿下是該吃點苦頭了。」 原來，我的媽媽竟然是暴君的女兒，而爸爸則是廢除了那位暴君的公爵。 講沒兩句，就聽到媽媽的離婚宣言…… 他們倆到底是什麼關係，有沒有人能跟我解釋一下啊？！
